doc.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

title: Wife's view and goodbyes
summary: Light remarks about his wife, then thanks and sign-off.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I think from growing up on a farm, and outside Buffalo, you did very well for yourself.

Thank you. I wish my wife thought so. That’s — don’t quote that. No. Well you know why she’s had nothing to do with music and no real interest in that, she’s a registered nurse, and a wonderful, wonderful person, but no really understanding of music or the music business. Got great ears. She’ll hear something and say oh that’s wrong or this is
right or something, but doesn’t know why and never really cared or wanted to care about music as a business.
Well on behalf of the college I’d like to thank you for being here today and—
Again, thank you for having me.
